edits.current:
- name: Check alias-named generic records in browser pages, React effects and workers
        id: generic_record_browser
        timeout-minutes: 60
        env:
          LEAN_BRIDGE_GENERIC_RECORD_BROWSER_TEST: "1"
          LEAN_BRIDGE_TYPE_CORPUS_BROWSERS: chromium,firefox,webkit
          LEAN_BRIDGE_LAKE_ENGINE: build/locked-lake-engine/bin/lean-bridge-component-engine
          LEAN_BRIDGE_LAKE_RUNTIME_ROOT: build/consumer-ci-runtime/lazy
        run: |
          node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/generic-records-browser.test.mjs
          test -s build/generic-records/browser.json
      - name: Preserve browser generic-record observations
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: generic-records-browser-${{ github.sha }}
          path: build/generic-records/browser.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30
